full_judgment: 4. The case of the plaintiff, in short, was that the lands of R.S. Khatian No. 2243 originally belonged to Sayed Ahmed, Bacha Miah and Anu Miah. Anu Miah sold out his entire share to Kalu Miah @ Kala Miah by registered kabala dated 24.02.1948. Kalu Miah @ Kala Miah subsequently sold out his purchased land to Mir Kashem Chowdhury the son of Bacha Miah and the defendant Nos. 4 to 6 the sons of Sayed Ahmed by registered kabala dated 04.12.1957. Bacha Miah died leaving two sons Alamgir Chowdhury and Mir Kashem Chowdhury. Sayed Ahmed died leaving sons-the defendant Nos. 4 to 6. Subsequently Mir Kashem Chowdhury also died leaving sons the defendant Nos. 7 to 11. Thus the defendant Nos. 4 to 11 acquired total 93 decimals of land in the suit khatian. That the plaintiff purchased 41 decimals of land from this defendant Nos. 4 to 11 by registered kabala dated 12.07.1988. The plaintiff executed a kabuliyat dated 04.09.1988 also in favour of his full brother Mir Kashem in respect of the suit land. That the defendants have got no right, title and possession in the suit land. The defendant Nos. to 3 filed Other Class Suit No. 85 of 1988 for permanent injunction in the court of Assistant Judge, Patiya against the defendant Nos. 4 to 11 the predecessors-in-interest of the plaintiff. That suit was subsequently transferred to the court of Additional Assistant Judge, Patiya and was renumbered as Other Class Suit No. 52 of 1990. The defendant Nos. 4 to 11 contested in that suit. The plaintiff filed an application in that suit for being added as defendant but that application was rejected. That suit was ultimately decreed. The predecessors of the plaintiff filed Title Appeal No. 403 of 1990 against the judgment passed in O.C. Suit No. 52 of 1990, but that appeal was dismissed. That the plaintiff prayed for being added as party in that appeal also but that prayer also was rejected. That the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 on the strength of that judgment and decree passed in Other Class Suit No. 52 of 1990 and in Other Appeal No. 403 of 1990 denied the plaintiff's title in the suit land and thus the plaintiff was compelled to file the suit.
